methods.name: Rapid Landslide Detection-WofE (RLD-WofE) model
methods.summary: An integrated approach that combines remote sensing indices (NDVI, NDMI, BSI, and SAR amplitude ratio) calculated in Google Earth Engine with a Weight of Evidence (WofE) landslide susceptibility model implemented in ArcGIS to identify potential landslide areas while minimizing false positives.
methods.source: Chrysafi, A.-A.; Tsangaratos, P.; Ilia, I.; Chen, W.
methods.verbatim: This resulted in the creation of the Rapid Landslide Detection-WofE (RLD-WofE) model.

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the RLD-WofE model lacks a repository or persistent link.
